error.message:
newspec-c: record-only → passed (record only (every judged cell passed, the rest is recorded only))
Our own addition: record-only, findings are suggestions. Same run as S23. The pad is full screen on all three profiles (1280x800, 412x839, 393x659); the box, chip, suggestion, Link, Assign to patient, Dictate, Delete compartment, Close and New compartment are visible and the topmost element at their centre. Phone tap sizes: Link 352/333x37, Assign 147x30, Dictate 87x28, Close 40x40 px (>= 24 px, < 44 pt), New compartment 46 px tall; Delete compartment 22x22 px is under 24 px but passes the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception (nearest other target 38 px from its centre). The picker (26 rows, 1012 px of content in a 562 px / 418 px sheet) scrolls: by wheel on desktop and Pixel 7; on iPhone 15 WebKit the emulated wheel did not move it and a scrollBy did (worth a look on a real iPhone). No sideways scroll and nothing covered on the pad or the picker. Finding (suggestion): with the failed-assign error, on Pixel 7 and iPhone 15 the global red error banner sits over the pad's header - the 'Quick dictation' title and its Close button - and over the pad's own error line until the banner is dismissed (not on desktop).

Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: phone-width / WebKit variant.

Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S24 Pad and picker on phone width and WebKit

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Quick Dictation opens from the Hospital home screen (patient list). The physician dictates or types into a box and adds a new box for the next patient, so one pad holds several boxes. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 step 1)
  • U2 Each box has 'Assign to patient', which opens a patient picker. Assigning appends the box's text verbatim to the end of that patient's encounter note and marks the box as assigned. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 3; TFA-92582 steps 2-3)
  • U3 A box that starts with a room number (e.g. 'bed 415…') shows a room chip, and the picker suggests that room's patient. The physician still taps to assign; nothing auto-assigns. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 4; TFA-92582 step 4; TFA-92583 AC 3)

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Pixel 7 (Chromium) and iPhone 15 (WebKit) profiles

When Open the pad, type a room box, open the picker

Then Pad is full screen; box, chip, suggestion, Link, Assign, Dictate and delete are visible and tappable; the picker sheet scrolls; no sideways scroll; nothing covered

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): visual lane covered / overflow / truncated / tap-target checks on qd-pad and qd-picker; findings are evidence for a human
